context.body: The baptism in four witnesses · Mark 1:9–11
context.label: Canonical location

observations.body: Jesus comes from Nazareth, is baptized by John, and immediately sees the heavens torn open and the Spirit descending.
observations.label: The heavens are torn open over Jesus: action

observations.body: A voice directly addresses Jesus as beloved Son and names divine pleasure.
observations.label: The heavens are torn open over Jesus: response

observations.body: Nazareth · coming up from water · heavens torn open · you are my beloved Son
observations.label: Words in Mark 1:9–11

payload.posture: Read Mark 1:9–11 as the baptism in four witnesses evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The torn heavens, dove comparison, and direct address should not be silently replaced by another Gospel’s wording.
payload.title: The heavens are torn open over Jesus
